en.title: Organization Profile Setup
en.excerpt: Step-by-step guide to configuring official organization credentials, contact information, and branding assets on Archeris.
en.content:
Importance of Complete Organization Data

Your organization profile serves as the official identity for all published tournaments. Information configured here is automatically embedded into public tournament cards, PDF Result Books, target allocation sheets, and verified athlete certificates.

Configuring Profile Information

To update your organization details:

  1. Navigate to Organizer Dashboard from the top navigation.
  2. Click Organization Profile in the sidebar.
  3. Complete the required fields:
    • Organization Name: Official club, federation, or company title.
    • Domicile City & Province: Geographic location for regional filtering.
    • Official Address: Physical headquarters or primary archery range address.
    • Organization Bio: Brief background, founding year, and affiliated sports federations.
  4. Click Save Changes to publish the updates.

Logo and Visual Branding Guidelines

Upload a high-resolution organization logo to ensure clear rendering across digital displays and printed certificates:

  • Format: Transparent PNG or high-quality JPG.
  • Aspect Ratio: 1:1 square ratio (minimum 400x400 pixels, recommended 800x800 pixels).
  • File Size: Under 2MB to optimize page loading speeds.

Public Contact Channels

Provide an active WhatsApp hotline and official support email. These contact links appear directly on public event registration pages so participants can reach your committee regarding equipment inspections or schedule inquiries.

Organization Verification

Affiliated clubs and recognized national federation branches can request a verified organizer badge by submitting certification documents to Archeris support, establishing trust with prospective participants.
